meta.room_tax_note: 13.38% is the Clark County transient lodging tax for resort hotels. It is the figure printed in the county's licensing guide and on The Venetian's own hotel terms. The county PDF's internal title reads 'Sept 2018' even though its URL contains 'july-2021', so the document's revision date is not certain - flagged.
meta.note: resort_fee is the nightly fee the property itself publishes. No dated room rate was captured for any property: every official booking engine renders prices only inside JavaScript. The trip-cost calculator therefore reports a hotel total that excludes the room rate and says so.
